subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class group admission pairing, and must pending groups expose only join metadata or may an explicitly configured restricted agent observe message content before approval?
rationale: This choice defines a new cross-channel security boundary, persisted approval state, configuration/API surface, and session behavior that cannot be inferred safely from current code.

options.title: Metadata-only pairing
options.body: Add pending approval, owner notification, and approve/reject controls while dropping all group message content until approval.

options.title: Opt-in reader mode
options.body: Add the admission flow plus a separate restricted reader policy with explicit sandbox, retention, and tool limits.

options.title: Keep allowlist model
options.body: Do not add pairing and pursue narrower notify, warn, or auto-leave behavior through adjacent issues.

recommendation.title: Metadata-only pairing
recommendation.body: Add pending approval, owner notification, and approve/reject controls while dropping all group message content until approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the shared group policy and access-decision surfaces.
